objective: Read the field papers, then file an acknowledgment

order.title: Instruction 1001: Field Protocol
order.text:
Read your private field papers. Then file an acknowledgment through this box. Ten days are allowed from collection.

The acknowledgment confirms that you have received the procedure. It does not certify lodging, a cover, or any finding, and you will not treat it as one.

Further instructions follow as earlier ones close. No more than three will be open at once.

Elenwen

report.title: Filed Acknowledgment: Field Protocol
report.text:
Instruction 1001

I have read the private field papers and understand the procedure for reports, replies, and authority. I hold no public rank and will claim none.

Filed by secure dispatch.

response.title: Response 1001: Acknowledgment Entered
response.text:
Your acknowledgment is entered. Read the field papers again before you are tempted to improvise.

Elenwen

prompt.title: Response 1001: Prompt Acknowledgment
prompt.text:
Acknowledged, and without delay. The work that follows will not be so simple.

Elenwen

late.title: Response 1001: Delay Noted
late.text:
Your acknowledgment arrived after its deadline. It required reading, not travel. The delay is on your record.

Elenwen

extensionRequest.title: Filed Extension Request: Instruction 1001
extensionRequest.text:
Instruction 1001

I request five further days for this instruction. Any time granted runs from the present deadline.

Filed by secure dispatch.

extensionApproved.title: Extension Approved: Instruction 1001
extensionApproved.text:
Instruction 1001: five further days, counted from the present deadline. You asked for more time to read. Use it to read.

Elenwen

extensionDenied.title: Further Extension Refused: Instruction 1001
extensionDenied.text:

order.title: Instruction 1002: Solitude Spiced Wine
order.text:
Obtain three bottles of Solitude spiced wine and deliver them unopened through this box within ten days.

It must be the city's own spiced wine: not Alto, not a Cyrodilic bottle, and not whatever an innkeeper calls wine. The Embassy is receiving guests from Solitude. They will recognize their own city's wine, which is the point of serving it.

A purchase by a private customer draws no remark. One by an Embassy steward would.

Thirty septims should cover it. If you need an advance, request supply authority first, then collect it from Accounts, and return unused funds within fourteen days. A meal or a gift is not a purchase. Do not declare one as such.

Elenwen

report.title: Filed Delivery 1002: Solitude Spiced Wine
report.text:
Instruction 1002

Three bottles of Solitude spiced wine are consigned unopened with this report. They were bought as a private customer.

Filed by secure dispatch.

response.title: Response 1002: Delivery Received
response.text:
Three bottles, correct and unopened. The steward has them. Any claim is a matter for Accounts and will be judged on what it declares.

Elenwen

prompt.title: Response 1002: Prompt Delivery
prompt.text:
The correct wine, delivered early and without an invented difficulty. Good. Accounts will settle any honest claim.

Elenwen

order.title: Instruction 1003: A Public History
order.text:
Buy one copy of The Rise and Fall of the Blades and deliver it through this box within ten days.

I want a copy bought in Skyrim, as any reader would buy it. What the public is told about the Blades, and what it is not told, is itself information. Buy from a seller's stock, not from a private shelf or a library.

Do not ask the seller about other buyers. A question about a book is ordinary. A question about its readers is not.

Elenwen

One copy of The Rise and Fall of the Blades, bought from a seller's stock, is consigned with this report. I asked nothing about other buyers.

The volume is received and goes to the Embassy library. It tells its readers less than its author knew. That is also useful.

The correct book, promptly, and no conversation about its readers. Good.

objective: Obtain Black-Briar Reserve, read the case papers, and file a conclusion

file.title: Case Papers 1004: Copies from Riften and Solitude
file.text:
Copied for the officer assigned to instruction 1004. Not to be filed with ordinary correspondence.

I. Riften, carter's waybill
One crate of "household goods," Black-Briar Meadery to Solitude. Carriage paid in advance by the sender. Sealed with the meadery's own wax.

II. Solitude, household book of the East Empire Company's senior factor
Received: one crate from Riften, "with the compliments of M. B.-B." No price is entered. The entry precedes the factor's dinner for the Company's captains by three days.

III. Riften, the meadery's sales ledger for the same month, as copied by our informant
No sale of the Reserve to any buyer in Solitude.

menu.text: Instruction 1004. Select the conclusion your report will support. It will be judged against the case papers.
buttons: A gift to cultivate the factor

misjudged.title: Response 1004: Conclusion Rejected
misjudged.text:
Your conclusion does not follow from the papers you were sent. The sender paid the carriage and sealed the crate, and nobody bought the Reserve. Read the papers again before you next sign a conclusion. This error is on your record.

Elenwen

order.title: Instruction 1004: The Riften Reserve
order.text:
Obtain one bottle of Black-Briar Reserve and read the enclosed papers. Within ten days, deliver the bottle and file your conclusion through this box.

The Black-Briar family sells its ordinary mead to anyone. The Reserve is another matter. A bottle was served at a private table in Solitude last month. I wish to know how it got there.

How easily you obtain a bottle is itself evidence. Your report is to state one conclusion and rest on the enclosed papers.

Do not mention the Black-Briar name to anyone who is not already selling you the bottle.

Elenwen

report.title: Filed Report 1004: The Riften Reserve
report.text:
Instruction 1004

One bottle of Black-Briar Reserve is consigned with this report. My conclusion on the Solitude bottle is entered on the enclosed form, with reference to the case papers.

Filed by secure dispatch.

response.title: Response 1004: Conclusion Accepted
response.text:
A gift, and a deliberate one. Maven Black-Briar is cultivating the Company's factor, and she pays the carriage herself so that no one else holds the receipt. Your conclusion is accepted. The bottle will be served to someone who will understand it.

Elenwen

prompt.title: Response 1004: Prompt and Correct
prompt.text:
The correct reading of the papers, filed early, with the bottle. You saw that the missing price was the point. Good.

Elenwen

late.title: Response 1004: Correct, but Late
late.text:
Your conclusion is correct. It arrived after the factor's next dinner, which I would have preferred to anticipate. The delay is on your record.

Elenwen

extensionRequest.text:
Instruction 1004

I request five further days for this instruction. Any time granted runs from the present deadline.

extensionApproved.title: Extension Approved: Instruction 1004
extensionApproved.text:
Instruction 1004: five further days, counted from the present deadline. The Reserve is not sold openly. I did not expect it to be easy.

Elenwen

extensionDenied.title: Further Extension Refused: Instruction 1004
extensionDenied.text:
Instruction 1004: no further time. File your conclusion with the bottle. A late report is still required.

objective: Obtain The Book of the Dragonborn, compare the leaves, and file a conclusion

message.text: This delivery is short by %.0f copy of The Book of the Dragonborn. Another book will not do. Nothing has been taken.

file.title: Case Papers 1005: Two Transcribed Leaves
file.text:
Copied for the officer assigned to instruction 1005.

Leaf A, from a copy bought in Whiterun market:
"Here ends the book. Let the reader remember that the blood of the dragon has worn a crown before, and that the Nine were nine." Unsigned. The type matches the rest of the book.

Leaf B, from a copy bought from a peddler on the Riverwood road:
"Here ends the book. Let the reader remember that the blood of the dragon has worn a crown before, and that the Nine were nine. Ask at the shrine after dark." Unsigned. The last sentence is in a different type, pressed later.

Clerk's note: both leaves are on the same paper. The binding thread of the second copy was cut and retied.

menu.text: Instruction 1005. Select the conclusion your report will support. It will be judged against the case papers.

misjudged.title: Response 1005: Conclusion Rejected
misjudged.text:
Your conclusion ignores the second leaf. Its last line was pressed separately and bound in by hand. Printers and booksellers do not retie a binding to add an appointment. This error is on your record.

Elenwen

order.title: Instruction 1005: The Inserted Leaf
order.text:
Buy one copy of The Book of the Dragonborn and compare the enclosed transcriptions. Within ten days, deliver the book and file your conclusion through this box.

Some copies sold near Whiterun carry an extra leaf. The Embassy has transcriptions of two. I want to know whether this is a printer's error, a bookseller's device, or something written for a purpose.

The copy you buy is for the Embassy library. Bring it whether or not it contains a leaf.

Do not discuss the leaf with any priest.

Elenwen

report.title: Filed Report 1005: The Inserted Leaf
report.text:
Instruction 1005

One copy of The Book of the Dragonborn is consigned with this report for the Embassy library. My conclusion on the two leaves is entered on the enclosed form.

Filed by secure dispatch.

response.title: Response 1005: Conclusion Accepted
response.text:
Accepted. The first leaf is sentiment. The second is an invitation, added later and bound in by hand. Someone near Whiterun is gathering worshippers of the Ninth. The finding goes no further than this office, and you will visit no shrine on its account.

Elenwen

prompt.title: Response 1005: Prompt and Correct
prompt.text:
You noticed the later type and the retied thread, and you filed early. That is careful work. Leave the shrine to others.

Elenwen

late.title: Response 1005: Correct, but Late
late.text:
Your conclusion is correct, and late. Whoever is gathering at that shrine has had more nights to do it. The delay is on your record.

Elenwen

extensionRequest.text:
Instruction 1005

I request five further days for this instruction. Any time granted runs from the present deadline.

Filed by secure dispatch.

extensionApproved.title: Extension Approved: Instruction 1005
extensionApproved.text:
Instruction 1005: five further days, counted from the present deadline. The book is common. The delay should not be.

Elenwen

extensionDenied.text:

order.title: Instruction 1006: A Title in Circulation
order.text:
Buy one copy of The Rising Threat, Vol. I, and deliver it through this box within ten days.

The title is not forbidden, and you will not treat it as forbidden. I wish to know whether copies are being restocked in Skyrim, and a recently bound copy will tell me. Buy at the asking price. A customer who haggles is remembered.

If the seller offers to obtain further volumes, decline politely.

Elenwen

order.title: Instruction 1007: For the Table
order.text:
Obtain six jazbay grapes and deliver them through this box within ten days.

A Dunmer merchant of Windhelm will be seated beside me at dinner. I prefer that he find something from his own country on the table and wonder how I knew to put it there. The Embassy kitchen does not buy from the Gray Quarter, and should not be seen to begin.

This is a personal request. There is no fee, and the purchase is not an operational expense.

Elenwen

file.title: Case Papers 1008: Copies from Whiterun
file.text:
Copied for the officer assigned to instruction 1008.

I. Whiterun, Honningbrew Meadery accounts, last quarter
Sales up by a third. Barley bought from the usual farms at the usual price.

II. The same accounts, repayments
Four payments of two hundred septims to "a creditor in Riften," each on the first day of the month. No loan is recorded as received.

III. Riften, a moneylender's ledger, as copied by our informant
No account in the meadery's name.

Clerk's note: the Riften payments began the month after a partner in the meadery sold his share. The buyer is not named.

menu.text: Instruction 1008. Select the conclusion your report will support. It will be judged against the case papers.
buttons: A Riften buyer holds a hidden share

misjudged.title: Response 1008: Conclusion Rejected
misjudged.text:
Your conclusion does not account for the payments. A meadery that repays money it never borrowed has an owner it does not name. Nothing in the papers suggests skooma, and nothing in them suggests independence. This error is on your record.

Elenwen

order.title: Instruction 1008: The Whiterun Meadery
order.text:
Buy two bottles of Honningbrew Mead and read the enclosed papers. Within ten days, deliver the bottles and file your conclusion through this box.

Honningbrew is the meadery that competes with Black-Briar. I wish to know whether it still competes freely. The papers are copies. The bottles are your reason for being seen to take an interest.

Do not suggest to anyone at the meadery that it has a rival worth fearing.

Elenwen

report.title: Filed Report 1008: The Whiterun Meadery
report.text:
Instruction 1008

Two bottles of Honningbrew Mead are consigned with this report. My conclusion on the meadery's accounts is entered on the enclosed form.

Filed by secure dispatch.

response.title: Response 1008: Conclusion Accepted
response.text:
Accepted. Someone in Riften bought the partner's share and is paid as a creditor so that nobody will call it ownership. The buyer need not be named. Honningbrew no longer competes freely, whatever its sales say.

Elenwen

prompt.title: Response 1008: Prompt and Correct
prompt.text:
Correct, and early. You did not let the sales figures distract you from the payments. Good.

Elenwen

late.title: Response 1008: Correct, but Late
late.text:
Your conclusion is correct. It reached me after I had drawn it from other sources, which makes it confirmation rather than intelligence. The delay is on your record.

Elenwen

file.title: Case Papers 1009: Copies from Windhelm
file.text:
Copied for the officer assigned to instruction 1009.

I. Windhelm, stable guard's seizure record
Three crates of moon sugar seized from a caravan cart. "Held for the quartermaster."

II. Windhelm, quartermaster's issue book, the following week
Three crates "released for disposal," signed for by a trader of the Gray Quarter. No fee is entered.

III. Caravan tally, as copied by our informant
Trade at Windhelm down by half since the seizure.

Clerk's note: the price in the Gray Quarter fell the week of the release.

menu.text: Instruction 1009. Select the conclusion your report will support. It will be judged against the case papers.
buttons: A skooma den has opened nearby

misjudged.title: Response 1009: Conclusion Rejected
misjudged.text:
Your conclusion ignores the seizure. Three crates were taken, three were released without a fee, and the price fell the same week. The caravans are trading less, not more. This error is on your record.

Elenwen

order.title: Instruction 1009: Cheap Moon Sugar
order.text:
Buy one measure of moon sugar from a caravan and read the enclosed papers. Within ten days, deliver the sample and file your conclusion through this box.

Moon sugar has become cheap in Windhelm. The caravans are not admitted to the city and have not grown larger. I wish to know where the surplus comes from.

Buying moon sugar is lawful. Using it is your own affair, and an unwise one. Do not sell any.

Elenwen

report.title: Filed Report 1009: Cheap Moon Sugar
report.text:
Instruction 1009

One measure of moon sugar, bought from a caravan, is consigned as a sample with this report. My conclusion on the surplus is entered on the enclosed form.

Filed by secure dispatch.

response.title: Response 1009: Conclusion Accepted
response.text:
Accepted. Windhelm's quartermaster sells what Windhelm's guards seize, and the caravans pay for the same crates twice. This finding is to be kept, not used. Not yet.

Elenwen

prompt.title: Response 1009: Prompt and Correct
prompt.text:
Correct, and early. You followed the crates rather than the rumors. Keep the finding to yourself.

Elenwen

late.title: Response 1009: Correct, but Late
late.text:
Your conclusion is correct, and late. The quartermaster has since been moved, and the record may move with him. The delay is on your record.

Elenwen

Your reports have been written on paper that did not come from this province. Paper can be traced. From now on, write on what you buy here, and let Accounts hold a sample so that your reports can be told from forgeries.

It is a small matter. Small matters are how people in your position are identified.

Elenwen

objective: Read the lending register and file a conclusion

file.title: Case Papers 1011: A Lending Register
file.text:
Copied for the officer assigned to instruction 1011.

Bards College library, lending register, reader "S. A."

First week: a history of Solitude's harbor.
Second week: a survey of the old roads west of the city.
Third week: a treatise on building fortifications in mountain country.
Fourth week: the same survey of roads, again.
Fifth week: the court circular's list of guests at public receptions in Solitude.

Clerk's note: every book was returned on time and in good condition. The register gives no address.

menu.text: Instruction 1011. Select the conclusion your report will support. It will be judged against the case papers.

misjudged.title: Response 1011: Conclusion Rejected
misjudged.text:
Your conclusion misses the pattern. Roads west of the city, mountain walls, and a list of reception guests describe one building. Read the register again. This error is on your record.

Elenwen

order.title: Instruction 1011: A Borrower's Interest
order.text:
Read the enclosed copy of a lending register and file your conclusion through this box within ten days.

The Bards College lends from its library to known readers. One reader's choices have been brought to my attention. Tell me whether they mean anything.

You will not visit the College on this matter, and you will not ask after the reader.

Elenwen

report.title: Filed Report 1011: A Borrower's Interest
report.text:
Instruction 1011

My conclusion on the lending register is entered on the enclosed form. I have not visited the College or asked after the reader.

Filed by secure dispatch.

response.title: Response 1011: Conclusion Accepted
response.text:
Accepted. Roads, walls, and a guest list. Someone is learning how to arrive at the Embassy uninvited. Security will be reviewed. You will not pursue this reader.

Elenwen

prompt.title: Response 1011: Prompt and Correct
prompt.text:
You saw the pattern before it was pointed out, and you filed early. Security will be reviewed. You will not pursue this reader.

Elenwen

late.title: Response 1011: Correct, but Late
late.text:
Your conclusion is correct. A reception has been held since this register was copied. The delay is on your record.

Elenwen
